column1: # Reference transcriptions for the pilot recordings.
# Format: filename <TAB> Teochew orthography <TAB> Mandarin gloss
# ref_char  records what the speaker actually said in Teochew, written in
#           Chinese characters as used by the speaker (e.g. 食, 伊, 汝, 鼎).
# ref_gloss records the same proposition in standard written Mandarin
#           (e.g. 吃, 他, 你, 锅).
# Both columns are ordinary transcriptions that any Teochew-Mandarin bilingual
# can produce without phonological training. The distance between them is the
# quantity under investigation: it measures how much credit an ASR system can
# gain by rendering a Teochew utterance into a Mandarin-shaped written form.
# Note: edit this file only in a plain-text editor. Spreadsheet applications
# (Excel, Numbers) replace tab characters and break the format.
# The five rows at the bottom are recorded but not yet transcribed; uncomment
# each row once it is filled in.
# ---- Recorded but not yet transcribed; uncomment when filled in. ----
